record_text:
Key points.
Classes of fire. Class A: ordinary combustibles; B: flammable liquids; C: energized electrical; D: combustible metals; K: cooking oils.

Procedure.
Identify the fuel: wood, paper, and cloth are Class A; gasoline and grease are Class B; live electrical equipment is Class C. Match the agent: water suits Class A only — never use water on grease or electrical fires. Call for help: if the fire exceeds a wastebasket in size, evacuate and call emergency services.
